children: Abraham Tsedeniya, an officer serving as Sr. Vice President, reported sales of common stock on August 27, 2026. The filings show two direct sales totaling 7,000 shares at weighted average prices of $264.60 and $264.96 per share. The total reported sale amount was $1,852,413. Following the reported transactions, he directly owned 23,181 shares of common stock. The filer provided footnotes stating the reported prices are weighted averages and that detailed breakouts of the sale prices are available upon request.
